{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Check the `converted` status of QA orders
qa_converted = qa_orders['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the `status` of QA orders
qa_refunded = qa_orders['status'].value_counts()

# Since all QA orders are marked as converted (converted = 1) and completed (status = 'completed'),
# they would have artificially inflated the conversion rate if included.
# However, they are not real transactions and must be excluded.

# Now, compute conversion rates in the filtered dataset
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]
conversion_rates = filtered_sales.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print conversion rates and difference
conversion_rates, difference"}
